## Goal:

Use strava data to predict race performance times


## General Brainstorming

I believe that it should start with a measure of the strain of each workout, and then use that to build a fitness metric similar to how coros does it on their app. 

## Feature Engineering

- pace
- average pace by week
- weekly number of runs
- standard deviation of weekly distances
- cumulative load (distance in last X weeks)
- elevation gain
- fatigue metric (total miles and intensity)

## Riegel Formula:

$$
T_2 = T_1 \times (\frac{D_2}{D_1})^c
$$
Where $T_1$ and $D_1$ are your known time and distance, $T_2$ is the predicted time for distance $D_2$, and $c$ is the decay factor to reflect pace changing over different distances, typically regarded as 1.06.
